symptom_signature: lan bus float register contains denormal garbage, e.g. 1.4e-45 (int 1 bits interpreted as float)
likely_cause: AceFrameBuilder.PayloadOffset was 0x1C(28) instead of real-wire 0x18(24); sv u32 written 4 bytes too late shifted payload
probe: FlecsEmu.exe --selftest; T3 checks first 28 bytes and expects signal-area base = 0x18(24)

symptom_signature: iCem case state never enters Streaming; heartbeat register frozen; AddIn logs 34 CSV tokens per line
likely_cause: TrayApp.FormatLine emitted Time & Date + Unit Num (excludeFromTelemetry=true); real iCem FLECS parser skips them structurally, so expected 32 telemetry fields
probe: dotnet test FlecsEmu.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~Flecs453_GoldenLine; count commas in captured COM line
remediation: TrayApp.FormatLine must continue to skip variables where ExcludeFromTelemetry=true

symptom_signature: COM status: 'Access denied to COMx' or IOException
likely_cause: Serial port already opened by another process (iCem, terminal, another FlecsEmu)
probe: Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -match 'iCem|FlecsEmu|PuTTY'}; then try port open
remediation: Close the other process or select a free COM port in ComTab

likely_cause: ComPort string does not match an existing port
remediation: Select a valid port from the dropdown/list

symptom_signature: LAN status: 'Npcap not found. Install Npcap ...'
likely_cause: SharpPcap cannot load wpcap.dll (Npcap not installed or WinPcap API-compatible mode disabled)
remediation: Install Npcap with 'WinPcap API-compatible mode' checkbox selected; reboot if needed

symptom_signature: LAN status: 'Src MAC not set and adapter has no MAC'
likely_cause: LanTab srcMac textbox empty and opened adapter reports no MAC address
probe: Get-NetAdapter -Name '*82574L*' | Select MacAddress; AceLanEmitter auto-detect falls back to adapter MAC
remediation: Enter explicit src MAC in LanTab matching the 82574L adapter

symptom_signature: LAN status: 'SendPacket error ... access ... permission ... denied'
likely_cause: Raw socket packet injection requires Administrator privileges

symptom_signature: Manual value typed in LanTab does not reach wire, or oversized string signal edit is rejected
likely_cause: LanTab may call SetOverride before CanTransmit; signal ByteOffset+Size>124 cannot be embedded (e.g. Cmnt Ops Track Descript UC Size=120 @ Offset=8)
probe: FlecsEmu.exe --selftest T5 checks Pump A Pressure FF edit, Side A Kicked Out HX edit, and oversized UC guard
remediation: LanTab must call IManualSignalOverride.CanTransmit before SetOverride; provider guard already rejects overflow

symptom_signature: FlecsEmu starts with streams enabled despite no UI checkbox set, or window not restored
likely_cause: settings.xml loaded with stale values; additive schema tolerated corrupt files
remediation: Edit or delete settings.xml; missing file ⇒ defaults; changes saved on ExitApplication
